Container.Name: Indigo Stats
Container.Overview: Private PurpleAir dashboard with minute-level local collection, historical charts, optional weather and air-quality comparisons, and an installable PWA. State is stored in SQLite on persistent appdata. No login is included: use a trusted LAN or private tailnet and do not expose the app directly to the internet.
Container.Description: Indigo Stats polls a PurpleAir sensor on the local network every minute and stores temperature, humidity, PM2.5, US AQI, and history in SQLite. Optional forecasts use privately configured coordinates. The container does not modify host services, routes, or Tailscale configuration. HTTPS through an owner-managed private proxy is needed for mobile PWA installation.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: PurpleAir air quality AQI PM2.5 weather environment PWA
Container.Requires: A reachable PurpleAir sensor on the same private network. Optional outbound HTTPS access for forecasts.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: HTTP port on the trusted LAN. Use a private HTTPS proxy for mobile PWA installation. The application has no login.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and local snapshots. Keep this directory when updating or replacing the container. Use local SSD-backed appdata, not SMB/NFS.

Config.Name: PurpleAir sensor IP
Config.Description: Private LAN IPv4 address of the PurpleAir device. Reserve its DHCP address. The app does not scan the subnet.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for charts, such as America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

Config.Name: PM2.5 method
Config.Description: cf1 preserves the raw channel-average PM2.5. epa2021 applies the US outdoor correction using raw humidity.

Config.Name: Temperature and humidity
Config.Description: purpleair matches PurpleAir estimated ambient layers. raw shows operating sensor readings. simple applies -8 F and +4 humidity points. Raw values are always retained.

Config.Name: Enable regional forecasts
Config.Description: Enable only after supplying both coordinates. Coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for regional weather and PM2.5 forecasts.

Config.Name: Forecast latitude
Config.Description: Optional private latitude from -90 to 90. Enter both coordinates or leave both blank.

Config.Name: Forecast longitude
Config.Description: Optional private longitude from -180 to 180. Coordinates are not returned by browser APIs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by the application after startup. Unraid nobody is normally 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by the application after startup. Unraid users is normally 100.
